}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of font-size?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>rem</code></li><li>B. <code>px</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>D. <code>always</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1487">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1488 / 8000 · Practice 4</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1489">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1489" data-page="1489" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 612"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 4</span><span>Page 1489 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 612 — button × grid-template-columns</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-template-columns</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-template-columns</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. Which styles apply before start / after end.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h1&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:23.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 1</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h1&gt;Heading level 1&lt;/h1&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-fill-mode</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h1 { animation-fill-mode: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of appearance?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>none</code></li><li>D. <code>banana2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1497">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1498 / 8000 · Practice 4</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1499">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1499" data-page="1499" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 622"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 4</span><span>Page 1499 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 622 — hr × offset-distance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">hr</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-distance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-distance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;hr&gt;</code> — a thematic break between paragraphs (scene change, topic shift). Position along the offset-path (0%–100%).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;hr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><p style="margin:0 0 6px">Before the break.</p><hr style="border:none;border-top:2px solid #d1d5db;margin:8px 0"><p style="margin:0">After the break.</p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Before the break.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt;After the break.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>offset-distance</b> = <b>percentage</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>hr { offset-distance: percentage; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of animation-play-state?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>running</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>paused</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>D. <code>banana</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1498">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1499 / 8000 · Practice 4</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p1500">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p1500" data-page="1500" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 623"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 4</span><span>Page 1500 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 623 — dialog × margin-right</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dialog</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-right</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-right</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dialog&gt;</code> — a native dialog box: modal when shown with showmodal(), non-modal when shown with show(). Distance to the right of the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dialog&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:14px;font-size:13px"><b>Are you sure?</b><div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;margin-right:6px;font-size:12px">Cancel</button><button style="border:none;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px">OK</button></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dialog id=&quot;dlg&quot;&gt; &lt;form method=&quot;dialog&quot;&gt; &lt;p&gt;Are you sure?&lt;/p&gt; &lt;button value=&quot;cancel&quot;&gt;Cancel&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button formnovalidate&gt;OK&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt; &lt;/dialog&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-right</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dialog { margin-right: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Makes the element&#x27;s content editable in place. true / false / plaintext-only. The browser shows a plain text-editing UI.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>inert</code></li><li>B. <code>itemtype</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>contenteditable</code></li><li>D. <code>slot</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p1499">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 1500 / 8000 · Practice 4</span> <a data-nav="next" href="../volumes/vol-04.html#p1501">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); if(!pageEl) return; // hash scroll function goHash(){ if(location.hash){ var t = document.querySelector(location.hash); if(t) t.scrollIntoView(); } } window.addEventListener('load', goHash); window.addEventListener('hashchange', goHash); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; bi < boxes.length; bi++){ (function(box){ box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key !== 'Enter') return; var n = parseInt(box.value, 10); if(!n || n < 1 || n > 8000){ box.value=''; box.placeholder='1–8000'; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
